# REGRESSION REFERENCE: # These values were produced by the BTCS solver itself at commit ae797e6. A mismatch with a later run means that the code changed; the file is never edited by hand.
# Why the values are believable: independent_check.csv beside this file compares the release fraction of this case with a reference that contains no BTCS code.
# reference: closed-form series of the homogeneous sphere with a kernel-step start (analytical::homogeneous_sphere)
# check: (a) the observed orders round to 1 in time and 2 in space (|order - 1| < 0.5 and |order - 2| < 0.5); (b) |F_reference - F_limit| <= 0.05 |F_btcs - F_reference| + floor
where F_limit = F_btcs - e_time - e_space + e_cross is the limit estimated from the dt/2
column8: 2n) refinements with the order read from the data (the cross term is added back because the time and space estimates each contain it). The 0.05 is a convention
column9: not a derived tolerance; the orders
column10: the uncertainties u of the estimates and the limit difference are measurements. See the module documentation of validation::regression.
